DHAKA, Nov 8, 2022 (BSS) - The general point-to-point inflation in the country eased further to 8.91 per cent in October down from 9.10 per cent in September.

The country's general point-to-point inflation increased to 9.52 percentage points in August. However, it declined to 9.10 percentage points in September.
